shapes.name: realworld_call_and_expression_stack
shapes.notes: Stage 4 recovers CPython 3.11 logical COPY/SWAP stacks, nested and multiline conditional expressions, comparison chains, f-string values, ordinary callback lambdas, CALL/PRECALL/KW_NAMES evaluation order, and return values carried across loop/finally cleanup. Stage 6 exposes 11 deeper composite statement regions whose generic final failure is tracked explicitly by the real-world release policy without changing this verified core shape contract.

shapes.name: realworld_comprehension_and_iterator_protocol
shapes.notes: Stage 6 recovers incremental LIST_APPEND, SET_ADD, and MAP_ADD consumers; EXTENDED_ARG-prefixed FOR_ITER loops; terminal loop bodies; conditional comprehension outputs; Boolean and conditional filters; chained comparisons; closure generators; yield from; and generator lambdas. The fixed 604-file archive has no remaining comprehension/iterator-protocol failure classification.

shapes.name: realworld_exception_cleanup_control_transfer
shapes.notes: Stage 3 verifies the canonical exception-cleanup fixture, but Stage 4 exposes 25 advanced nested return/call/control-transfer layouts in recognized exception-table regions. They retain exact parser diagnostics with an exception-cleanup shape hint and fail closed instead of falling through to ordinary expression recovery.

shapes.name: realworld_function_object_flow
shapes.notes: Stage 5 preserves delayed lambda values through attribute, subscript, collection, default-value, closure, descriptor, and decorator consumers with differential behavior coverage.

shapes.name: realworld_import_protocol
shapes.notes: Remediation stage 2 keeps dotted and from-import references in an explicit transaction across SWAP/POP operations, with binding and exception behavior coverage for aliases, multiple names, relative imports, missing modules, and circular imports.

shapes.name: realworld_match_boundary
shapes.notes: Stage 4 bounds match lookahead at ordinary call, collection builder, function creation, and store operations, preventing expression code from being misclassified as a match statement. The fixed 604-file archive has no remaining match-boundary failure classification.

shapes.name: realworld_recursive_structure
shapes.notes: Phase 8 converts internal RecursionError escapes into contextual Python311ParseError failures.

shapes.name: realworld_unpack_assignment
shapes.notes: Remediation stage 1 recursively binds nested UNPACK_SEQUENCE and UNPACK_EX assignment, for-loop, and comprehension targets while preserving success and exception behavior.

shapes.name: realworld_with_control_transfer
shapes.notes: Phase 8 records with-body return, yield, and cleanup control transfers that are not one safely recoverable expression.
